prTitle: fix: feature/IBR-14610-new-cta-pcp add pcp only CTA label

analysis.summary: One high-severity crash identified in error handling logic due to unsafe property access on a potentially null error object.

bugs.title: Potential null pointer crash in error handler
bugs.description: The function accesses 'error.config' without optional chaining or a null check. However, the logic at the start of the function (Line 72) uses optional chaining ('error?.response?.data'), which explicitly acknowledges that 'error' can be null or undefined.
bugs.risk: If the error handler is called with a null or undefined error object (which can occur in certain promise rejection scenarios or custom error flows), the BFF will throw a TypeError and crash instead of returning the intended 500 error response.

notBugs.reason: The change from '=== false' to '=== true' for the preview flag is an intentional correction of a logic error where preview mode was previously only enabled if the parameter was false.

The destructuring of 'cartTypeMap' from 'appContextData as AppModel' is covered by a type assertion. Per instructions, we assume the developer has verified the existence of these fields in the asserted type.
Importing a hook from a 'feature-app' folder into a 'legacy' component is a common pattern in this repository and does not indicate a functional bug.
